description: Defines utility functions and a class for file operations within the ocudulog namespace, including error formatting, filename splitting, and basic file handling (create, write, flush, close).

classes.name: file
classes.description: Provides basic file operations such as create, write, flush, and close, with error handling and state management.

methods.name: format_error
methods.description: Formats system error messages with a given error string and error code.

methods.name: split_filename_extension
methods.description: Splits a filename into its base name and extension, handling edge cases like hidden files and directories.

methods.name: build_filename_with_index
methods.description: Constructs a filename with an index appended before the extension.
